Approved universities in non-majority English speaking countries or territories (non-MESC)
Approved universities in non-majority English speaking countries or territories (non-MESC)
We accept degrees that are taught and assessed entirely in English from these universities as meeting our English language entry requirements.
Degrees taught and assessed in English
Universities which teach and assess only in English in this list are marked with an asterisk (*).
If the university that awarded your degree does not teach solely in English, it is your responsibility to provide evidence that your degree has been taught and assessed in English.
Visiting students
If you are a visiting student who is studying for a degree that is taught and assessed entirely in English at one of these approved universities, but you have not yet completed your degree, we will accept you as meeting the English language entry requirements as long as you have successfully completed one full year of study.
How old your degree can be
If you are not a national of a majority English speaking country or territory, as defined by UK Visas and Immigration (UKVI), then your degree must be no more than five years old at the start of the month in which your programme of study begins.
